remediation.suggestion: Describe this distribution as a review guide. Remove complete-coverage and privacy guarantees, and distinguish separately supplied scanner functionality from included content.

content.user_title: Review FastAPI Repository Security Before Deployment
content.value_statement: FastAPI repositories can contain exposed credentials, unsafe SQL queries, and unprotected webhooks. This guide organizes an agent-assisted review of these risks before deployment.
actual_capabilities: Defines review targets for hardcoded API keys, tokens, database credentials, and committed environment files.
Outlines checks for debug mode, permissive CORS, and broad network bindings.
Identifies raw SQL construction and unparameterized execution as review priorities.
Directs attention to missing webhook HMAC or signature verification.
Highlights Pydantic request models as a route validation check.
Provides an illustrative severity report and deployment decision format.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; scanner scripts, extension source, and automation templates are absent.
Deterministic AST scanning and complete coverage cannot be verified from this distribution.
Static review can miss runtime behavior and vulnerabilities involving dynamic string evaluation.
Privacy depends on the agent environment; this guide does not enforce local execution or prevent external processing.

use_cases.title: Review an API Before Release
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to inspect credentials, configuration, SQL queries, and webhook verification before approving a FastAPI release.

use_cases.title: Assess a Legacy Service
use_cases.description: Organize a repository review around the documented FastAPI risks and request evidence for each reported issue.

use_cases.title: Define Deployment Review Criteria
use_cases.description: Translate the documented checks into review criteria, then implement and test separate tooling for CI enforcement.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Focused Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this FastAPI repository for exposed secrets and insecure CORS settings. Report evidence and redact credential values. Do not modify files.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Queries and Request Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect FastAPI routes for unsafe SQL construction and missing Pydantic validation. Cite real files and explain each risk. Separate confirmed issues from uncertainty.

prompt_templates.title: Trace Webhook Verification
prompt_templates.prompt: Trace each webhook from request receipt to side effects. Identify missing signature verification, cite evidence, and propose focused fixes and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Deployment Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the FastAPI repository against this guide. Use only available tools and disclose missing scanner support. Prioritize findings and propose independently testable deployment criteria.

best_practices: Request file and line evidence for each finding, and redact secrets from reports.
Verify available tooling before relying on automated scanning or CI enforcement.
Combine repository review with runtime tests and independent security tooling.
anti_patterns: Treating the guide as an installed deterministic scanner.
Assuming complete vulnerability coverage or guaranteed privacy from descriptive claims.
Publishing credential values or approving deployment without validating reported fixes.

faq.question: Does this package include a runnable scanner?
faq.answer: No. The included file is a public guide. It explicitly excludes scanner scripts, extension source, and templates.

faq.question: Which security topics does the guide cover?
faq.answer: It covers exposed secrets, unsafe SQL, insecure FastAPI configuration, webhook signature verification, and Pydantic request validation.

faq.question: Which technologies does it target?
faq.answer: The guide targets Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Pydantic, Uvicorn, and SQLAlchemy or raw SQL drivers.

faq.question: Can it automatically block a deployment?
faq.answer: Not by itself. The guide describes deployment gating, but executable scanner logic and CI integration are not included.

faq.question: Does it guarantee complete security coverage?
faq.answer: No. Complete coverage claims are unsupported by the included files. Static review can also miss dynamic behavior and runtime vulnerabilities.

faq.question: Does it keep repository data entirely local?
faq.answer: The guide does not enforce local processing. Data handling depends on your agent, model provider, tools, and configuration.
